integrity: Every all-dimensional assertion is supported by a mathematical proof; exact finite enumerations provide checks only. No independent external mathematical audit has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean metric is the standard coordinate metric in the zero-sum hyperplane; no enumeration of noncontact facets in all dimensions and no complete inequality-minimal description of the center polytope is asserted. Equivalent literature under other finite-metric terminology remains a risk.
title: Sharp Euclidean inballs and high-dimensional center freedom in hypercube symmetric edge polytopes
